answer.reason: Several verses tell of events at Zorah, notably Samson's burial and the Danite expedition that set out from it.

clauses.english: was where Samson was buried in his father Manoah's burying place
clauses.quote: buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol

clauses.english: was where six hundred armed Danites set out to seek a new land
clauses.quote: six hundred men appointed with weapons of war

doubts: Samson's burial and the Danite departure are both stated as 'between Zorah and Eshtaol' or 'out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol', so the place is shared with Eshtaol.
The list verses (JOS 15:33, JOS 19:41, 2CH 11:10, NEH 11:29, 1CH 2:53-54) only name it, so they were not used.
